review_batches.context: Examined0-83 and complete149-row Debish battle after reveal. Grooming/color gag, missing Daifozon, Sharl all-gathered/withdrawal, Gen enters Zeifon, safety/aptitude claims, Ivel sends sword and power rises.
review_batches.decisions: Appearance/mood not actual new build setting; all-gathered speech no omniscient roster claim. Gen first-time combat not endorsed invulnerability, mechanics opinions qualified. Daifozon arrives later distinct Zeulear, source Rayblade sword. Pranya accepted cat pun, no numeric stat, biological method or confirmed death.
